name: Dawn & Dusk
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Soft and literary: a warm dawn page and a muted dusk one, a Georgia serif body, iris accents, a rose quote rule and six gentle heading hues. On the Rosé Pine palette.

zh.description: 柔和而有书卷气：温暖的黎明白天页和低调的黄昏夜间页，正文用 Georgia 衬线，鸢尾紫点缀，玫瑰色引用线，六级标题各有柔和的颜色。基于 Rosé Pine 配色。
